name: EquipmentQualificationTracker
tagline: IQ, OQ, PQ and requalification for every GMP asset – with QA e-signatures, deviations and live validation status.
description: A complete GMP equipment qualification app for Power Apps and Power Pages: a validation dashboard, an equipment lifecycle grid (DQ, IQ, OQ, PQ, requalification), a protocol register with bulk actions and a status board. QA pre-approval and approval e-signatures, the IQ → OQ → PQ sequence, test-case results, deviations from protocol that block approval, four-eyes rules, re-execution after failure and one-click requalification planning. Works the moment it is dropped (demo mode) and connects to Dataverse, SharePoint, Excel, SQL or a collection without JSON.
features: Derived equipment status: qualified, requalification due/overdue, in qualification, on hold
QA pre-approval and approval e-signatures with four-eyes rules
Deviations from protocol that block QA approval, closure with impact assessment
Next requalification from approval date and interval by GMP impact
Bulk start, owner, reschedule, reminders, CSV export
Undo, validation and audit-style history lines
Phone layout with bottom view switcher
Power Fx outputs and six events
